property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any callee address that reverts when called, C.transfer either reverts (propagates failure) — i.e., does not return true — while the mutant that removes require(_s) will return true even when the callee call fails; thus the reference always reverts (does not return true) when a callee reverts, but the buggy version can return true for some inputs.
change_summary: Remove the require(_s) so failed external calls do not revert and transfer returns true when callee call returns false, changing observable return value.
